label: Comet
note: Comet has 8 printed parts. The three paint entries (viewOnly, qty 0, no print file) exist only so the 3D viewer can show the painted details in color: paint them onto the printed head with acrylic paint pens. The stripes, whiskers and mouth stay grooves in the viewer (paint them #7f8ba6). The chest board goes in from the back and is closed by comet_back_cover.

parts.label: Body, arms, legs, paws and tail
parts.orientation: Upright on its paws, the flat underside of the tail on the bed
parts.supports: Tree supports under the belly between the paws, under the two hands and under the curled tip of the tail. None for the chest seat, the channels or the 22 mm pocket; the pocket and the 20.3 mm hatch bridge, so print with the bridge fan on.
parts.notes: Pause at 7.5 mm to swap to the light colour (#edf1f7) for the paws, or paint them. Press two M3 heat-set inserts into the 4.0 x 6.5 mm holes in the paws (x = +-12). The 7 mm cable channel runs from the sole up into the chest pocket, the 5 mm LED channel from the pocket up through the neck and its 10 x 6 mm peg. The chest pocket is 22 x 22 x 15 mm behind a 1.2 mm front wall (a 7 mm hole lets the tag's stem through) and is reached from the BACK through the 20.3 x 20.3 mm hatch: the chest board (up to about 19.6 x 19.6 mm) slides in from the back, switch facing forward. The chest also has a recess for the belly inlay and a seat for the tag bezel. The tail rests on the pad and never touches the hatch. About 76 x 39 x 55 mm.

parts.label: Back cover (closes the hatch)
parts.orientation: Inner face down, outer face up
parts.notes: A 20 x 20 mm plug that follows the back of the body: 0.15 mm clear a side in the hatch, press fit plus a drop of glue. Its inner face is the pocket's back wall, so the chest board rests against it and a press on the tag cannot push the board away. Fit it last, after the board and its wires.

parts.label: Head with ears
parts.orientation: Chin (flat) on the bed, ears up
parts.supports: Tree supports under the cheeks around the chin (the first 8 mm). None for the ears.
parts.notes: Paint the inner faces of the ears pink (#f2a9cb), the raised nose #e88db6, the eye recesses #14121e (or glue in black inserts, 1.4 mm deep) and the forehead stripes, whiskers and mouth grooves #7f8ba6. A 10.4 x 6.5 mm socket goes over the neck peg. A straight 5 mm channel runs 45 degrees up and back from the socket to a 10.6 mm seat on the back of the head for LED 1 (a 10 mm board facing up and back, so the whole dome glows): thread its three wires through the channel, the peg and the body before gluing the head on. About 46 x 38 x 47 mm.

parts.label: Collar and tag bezel
parts.orientation: Upside down: the flat top of the ring and of the tongue on the bed, the diamond plate standing up
parts.supports: None. The diamond's lower edges are 45 degrees.
parts.notes: Slides over the neck onto the shoulders. The tongue leaves through the notch at the front of the dome's bottom band; the 15.6 mm diamond plate is glued into the seat on the chest and holds the tag cap (10.6 mm window, a 12.8 mm pocket behind the 1.6 mm lip for the cap's flange). Press the cap in from behind before gluing the collar on.

parts.label: Tag cap (the talk button)
parts.notes: A 10 mm square turned 45 degrees (about 14 mm across), 0.3 mm clear in the bezel's window, with a 12.2 mm flange behind the lip so it cannot fall out and a 5.6 mm stem that presses the 6 x 6 mm switch. The stem tip stops 0.3 mm short of a 9.5 mm switch on a 1.6 mm board resting against the back cover. There is 0.8 mm of travel before the flange meets the front wall.

parts.label: Belly inlay
parts.orientation: Outer face down on the bed (flat over the chest, the lower end arches up)
parts.notes: Glue it into the oval recess on the chest (24 x 25 mm, 1.2 mm deep); it stands 0.4 mm proud and has a hole where the bezel plate sits. Optional: leave it out and paint the recess #edf1f7 instead.

parts.label: Glass helmet, top half
parts.supports: Tree supports inside the top 10 mm, where the wall leans more than 45 degrees; none below that.
parts.notes: 66 mm outer diameter (parameter dome_d), 1.8 mm wall, centre 70 mm above the base; the whole figure is 103 mm tall. Glue it to the bottom band at the equator (clear epoxy or CA). A printed dome is translucent, not crystal clear: for a crystal clear helmet buy a 60 or 70 mm clear ornament ball, set dome_d to match and skip both dome parts.

parts.label: Glass helmet, bottom band
parts.orientation: Upside down: equator face down, the open bottom up
parts.supports: None for the first 23 mm; the last 5 mm lean in up to 58 degrees, so print them slowly with full cooling or add a few tree supports.
parts.notes: Open at the bottom (13.8 mm inside radius, 17.5 mm outside): it stands on the shoulders of the body around the collar. The notch in the front edge (6.4 mm wide) lets the collar's tongue out; set the notch over the tongue, then glue the rim to the shoulders and the top half to the band.

parts.label: Paint: ear insides (pink)
parts.notes: View only: a thin plate over the shallow recess in the front of each ear, so the 3D viewer can show them in their paint color. Not printed. Paint the inner faces of both ears on comet_head pink (#f2a9cb) with an acrylic paint pen.

parts.label: Paint: nose (rose pink)
parts.notes: View only: a thin skin over the raised nose, so the 3D viewer can show it in its paint color. Not printed. Paint the raised nose on comet_head rose pink (#e88db6) with an acrylic paint pen.

parts.label: Paint: eyes (dark)
parts.notes: View only: a thin plate over the two eye recesses, so the 3D viewer can show them in their paint color. Not printed. Fill the two eye recesses on comet_head (1.4 mm deep) with dark paint (#14121e) using an acrylic paint pen, or glue in black inserts instead.
